title: Barack Obama shares unexpected marriage update - NewsBreak
text:
By Knewz Staff ,
14 hours ago Former President Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama have been married for 33 years and share two adult children, Malia and Sasha. By: Aude Guerrucci – Pool via CNP / MEGA Former President Barack Obama’s relationship with former first lady Michelle Obama is back in the spotlight after he opened up about their marriage issues in a new interview, Knewz.com can reveal. During a conversation with historian David Olusoga at the O2 Arena in London, Barack spoke about the dark times he and the ex-FLOTUS endured following their time in the White House.
Barack’s confession Former President Barack Obama admitted he had to “dig myself out of a hole” with Michelle after they left the White House in 2017 following his two terms in office. By: @nprpodcasts/YouTube / MEGA “I was digging myself out of the hole I found myself in with Michelle,” Barack admitted during the event, quipping, “Now I’m at about level ground.” The 64-year-old’s comments came after the former first couple were spotted together for the first time in months in Portofino, Italy, on director Steven Spielberg’s $250 million superyacht. Back in April, the ex-president confessed to Hamilton College President Steven Tepper that after two terms in the White House, “I was in a deep deficit with my wife,” explaining he tried to get them back on track by “doing occasionally fun things.”
Michelle shuts it down Former first lady Michelle Obama has been frank about how difficult marriage to former President Barack Obama has been at times, especially during the height of his political career. By: MEGA Michelle has previously attempted to counter reports she and her husband were secretly splitting, using her “IMO” podcast, which she hosts with her big brother, Craig Robinson, to share her side of things. She’s said that when she and Barack aren’t in the same room together, “folks think we’re divorced.” She’s insisted they’re in it for the long haul, telling listeners, “There hasn’t been one moment in our marriage where I thought about quitting on my man, and we’ve had some really hard times. So we had a lot of fun times, a lot of adventures, and I have become a better person because of the man I’m married to.” However, the 61-year-old has also admitted to going through tough times with the ex-POTUS, confessing, “People think I’m being catty for saying this: It’s like, there were 10 years where I couldn’t stand my husband. … Marriage isn’t 50/50, ever. There are times I’m 70, he’s 30. There are times he’s 60, 40.” Despite their ups and downs, Michelle made it clear she’s sticking by Barack. “We will be married forever. So, let’s say we live long. It will be 50-plus years. And if 10 of those years were bad, you know, anybody would take those odds.”
Secret negotiations? Sources previously claimed Barack and Michelle Obama were quietly discussing how to split up their post-White House fortune. By: MEGA While both Barack and Michelle have done their best to mitigate rumors, speculation of trouble in their union is still rampant, with one insider claiming the pair are quietly attempting to divide their $70 million empire. “They want to have everything ironed out in advance. The last thing they want is an ugly fight with lots of nasty legal filings,” a source previously claimed. “They have homes in [Washington] D.C., Martha’s Vineyard and Chicago, plus a stock portfolio in excess of $25 million. There are also substantial revenue streams from their various media projects to divide and manage going forward.” According to that source, “It’s far from easy to untangle a life of three decades with someone, but maintaining the illusion of a happy and stable marriage is no longer a solution. They both are of the mind that they will be better off on their own.” Another insider claimed the couple were enjoying their “separate lives” until things took a turn when Barack decided to dip his toe back into politics recently. That source claimed, “They’d already been living separate lives on opposite coasts for some time, but that was no longer an option after Michelle refused to run [for president] and Barack was forced to back Kamala [Harris].”
Marriage milestone Barack and Michelle Obama publicly posted loving messages to each other on social media to mark their 33rd wedding anniversary in early October. By: MEGA In early October, the Obamas marked their 33rd wedding anniversary. “The best decision I ever made was marrying you, @MichelleObama. For 33 years, I’ve admired your strength, grace and determination — and the fact that you look so good doing it all. Happy anniversary!” he wrote on Instagram. She posted a message, too, writing, “We’ve been on quite the journey over the last 33 years — and yet, I love you even more today than the day we said ‘I do.’ Happy anniversary, @BarackObama! I’m so lucky to go through life with you.”
